name: Bahrain International Circuit
notes: Bahrain International Circuit, Grand Prix layout (clockwise). Raceway loop over the three 'Grand Prix Circuit' ways. The Outer, Inner and Endurance links are excluded. Traced 5355 m vs 5412 m. Start line from the middle of the pit lane. One DRS zone on the pit straight as in 2012. Values from 2012 F1: race laps, pit lane loss and overtaking are approximate. tyre_wear_mult and the wet weather multiplier are first guesses and will be tuned. speed_scale is 1.0 until the lap time calibration against the 2012 pole. pole_side is the inside of the first corner (approximate).
